why: MIN_TEXT_H is about one line, persistence.ts's BOARD_LINE_H floor; a page-pin takes an aspect lock on RESIZE only, keyed to its pinned entry's kind (pinAspectFor)
the canvas stops at three page-widths tall, in the board's own units so a window resize never moves the floor; the shared 0.08 margin makes the canvas stop on the frame the card stops
a bounded notecard read (title + up to 3 lines, ~160 chars): it trims what the card's face shows, never what is stored
a card's face is plain text - the same reader as every other derived title
a page-pin reads its entry LIVE each render, deleted-inclusive so a Trash card shows its real title (travel stays live-only); a board-card's drawer line comes from store/pageHome.ts
a nested board rides the same page-pin box; its face is the noun `Board` and its drawer, and a doubled edge (::before) shows the kind without spending a colour
a read-only face (a double-click opens BoardCardPopup); a ported card (sourceEntryId) shows the bounded excerpt, so its full stored text cannot inflate the reflow floor
the resting card renders through the popup's decoration engine with no caret, so every marker collapses; escHtml keeps the HTML safe, and font-size:0 keeps the stored text in textContent
the card editor reuses Draft's engine (applyFormat, decorateMarkdown) on box.text, bold and italic only; Tab is trapped as in UnlockCeremony, and the paste wall stands
INLINE: the Walk's card IS this editor, mounted in place (no portal, backdrop, dock or Esc - Esc belongs to the Walk); autoFocus puts the caret in the card on every step
the styling dock starts closed (the Sliver's useState(false) at card scale); declared with the hooks, above any early return
FONT-SPAN: whether words are highlighted in the card, and their face - the dock's Typeface scopes and brass read it; declared with the hooks
a size for the HIGHLIGHTED words of this card only - the face's own road
the Whole card SIZE - the card's spans' sizes go (one undo step), then the card's size
the backdrop is portalled to <body>: inside .desk-frame-stage (isolation:isolate) its z-index ranked only within the stage, and the rail painted over it
non-null only while this board has no row yet: the first box writes the row; a titled board is born at once
a system board and a page's paired Plan board take no part in the way-back (the slot keeps the page's own departure); decided once per mount
connection mode: threadArmedFrom is the card whose corner square was double- or right-clicked; these are the rest of its render state (the card under the arm, the flash after a link or unlink)
click-to-create: a click on empty board makes a card, a click-drag sizes it first; refs, because the canvas's native pointer listeners must read the current answer
the box being resized now: the auto-grow effect skips it mid-drag, so the pointer alone sets w/h, and the content floor is reconciled once when the drag ends
when the last resize or move ended, so the canvas's double-click can tell a gesture's own second click from a request to edit
describePageHome knows nothing of system boards, so their home label comes from the lexicon here (trash, shelf, journal)
while a drawer narrows the board, the canvas keeps the width the board has with the drawers shut, so no card shrinks or moves - the board scrolls instead
drawers never cover a board's cards: the board area narrows to the room beside the open drawers while the canvas keeps its natural width (the board scrolls); the CSS reads --board-l / --board-r
FIT TO TEXT: drops sizedByHand and fits the card to its content on the reflow's own floors; a dealt deck's rows follow (rowFit)
a fontFace patch of `undefined` CLEARS the card's face (the key goes; absent = Default), it never stores an empty one
a removed card takes its hairlines in one undo snapshot; inert on a system board (its cards are derived); a deleted card is a tombstone (deletedAt), saved first so a fresh card is in storage to stamp
the label is the card's WORDS - its hidden marks (a style span's included) are dropped before it is read

New page card: a real loose page, pinned here in one act; the pin is APPENDED to this component's live boxes (never replaced by the store's copy), so the unmount save neither erases it nor drops unsaved cards
a gesture clears a text selection on the board as it starts and ends: left in place, the next press on the corner starts the browser's own text drag, which cancels the pointer

connection mode, from the corner square or the graft knob: a brass line arms to another card and a release toggles the link; lines show only in this mode, and the arm moves imperatively, not per React render
the browser's click after a release on a rail thumbnail would travel to its page; a short beat swallows it, so making a link never leaves the board
a right-button release over a rail thumbnail fires that tile's contextmenu; stopped here in the capture phase, its menu never opens after a link gesture
the lock's aspect comes from the PINNED ENTRY, never the box (a nested board's card is a page-pin box too and stays wide); deleted-inclusive so a Trash card keeps its shape
with a card selected, the FIRST empty-space press only deselects - it makes nothing; the next press, with nothing selected, is the one that creates
capture the pointer on the first pointerdown, not at the drag threshold: an uncaptured fast drag can hit-test outside the canvas and drop the gesture

the right edge stops a drag as the bottom does: the canvas width never grows (x and w are fractions of it); clamped on the shared delta, and floored at 0 so a card already past the edge is never yanked back
a page-pin takes its kind's canonical aspect only inside a resize the writer performs - never on load or on a move: constrain forward, never snap
the card keeps its proportions and follows the pointer on both axes: the axis the pointer moved more drives the size, so the corner stays under the hand; MIN_PIN_H floors it
a DELTA from the start size, so an outward drag never shrinks an older, differently shaped card: it takes its kind's shape at the first pixel and grows
Delete removes the selected card (a selected hairline takes the key first; never while typing or with a modifier); in connection mode the key belongs to the mode
the rename state lives with the other hooks, above the early return: hooks below `if (!initialEntry) return null` would change the hook count between renders
connection and board-meta boxes are never positioned cards; a page-pin with onCanvas === false is withheld from the wall (absence means displayed, so older pins still render)
the card menu leads with the conditional actions (Ungroup, Edit copy, Restore, Pin to a Board…), then a separator and Delete; a right-click on empty board offers New Card and Delete board
a survey row dropped on the canvas lands where dropped; only this board's own memberships are accepted, so a display act never becomes a card transfer
e.target is the canvas (it captured the pointer on the first press), so a fresh hit-test at the event's point finds the card that was double-clicked
a double-click on the resize corner opens nothing (it enters connection mode), and one within 100ms of a resize or move is that gesture's own click, never a request to edit
a system board's Add-family tools are ABSENT, never inert; the mode bar has its own .board-mode-* classes, and the PAGE door is every board's one exit, never a tab
an unpaired board's PAGE door opens an unborn page linked back: a pin on a user board, the belonging origin on a system board (Journal, Shelf); Trash keeps the exit
the mode bar renders on every board, its tabs only on a non-system board (role=tablist only when they are present); nestChain is this board's crumb
the telos line is not rendered (its lexicon entry stays): a board's pairing reads from its visible context
the draft derives with an empty fallback, so a nameless board opens a nameless field, with no sentinel string to keep in step
